common.csvHelp: Amounts in minor units (100 paisa = 1 taka); an empty cell means not known.
common.howH: How these figures are worked out
common.howSub: Open a line to see what it counts and where the full figure is.
common.cut: The first {n} rows are shown; the CSV has all of them.
common.noKey: This part needs the "Reports" key, which you do not have.
common.name: Name

note.future: The period ends today: later days have no figures yet.
note.swapped: From was after To, so the two days were turned round.
note.tooLong: One report covers at most {days} days, so the period starts later.

profit.title: Profit analysis
profit.sub: Which channels, categories and styles make the money
profit.heroTitle: Profit before ads, day by day
profit.callout: This page shows where profit comes from. The full profit and loss (every cost line) is in Money.
profit.byChannelSub: Delivered sales, then what is left after the channel's own ad spend
profit.byCategorySub: A category counts everything under it
profit.byStyleSub: All colours and versions of a style together
profit.uncosted: {n} delivered orders are left out of the profit because a product has no cost yet.
profit.adsUnknown: Ad spend is not known for part of this period, so net profit is not shown.

how.net: Contribution less ad spend, other costs and fixed costs. The same figure as Money › Profit & loss.
how.before: Delivered sales less returns, product cost, courier, fees, packaging and messages, plus delivery charges taken.
how.margin: Net profit as a share of the delivered sales that have a cost.
how.perOrder: Profit before ads divided by the delivered orders.
how.ads: Ad spend imported for the days of the period.
how.returns: Courier and handling lost on parcels that came back.
how.losing: Styles whose profit after their share of ads is below zero.

products.title: Product report
products.sub: What sells, what sits, and what to reorder
products.stylesSub: Best first. A style counts all its colours; see the profit rules in Money.
products.restockSub: Selling sizes are out or will run out soon. Reorder them from the ERP.
products.unsoldSub: In stock but nothing sold. Try a discount, a combo or better photos.

how.sales: Delivered sales of every style in the period.
how.restock: From the Report library: the verdict "restock" uses the days of stock set in its own settings.
how.unsold: From the Report library: in stock, nothing sold in the days set there.

marketing.title: Marketing & ads report
marketing.sub: What the ads bring back, campaign by campaign
marketing.offTitle: The marketing report is switched off
marketing.offBody: Switch it on in Marketing › Report, under "More options".
marketing.offAsk: Ask the owner to switch it on in Marketing › Report.
marketing.spendNone: No ad spend imported for these days
marketing.channelsSub: Ad channels first, then organic and the rest
marketing.campaignsSub: Campaigns with an order, a delivery or spend in the period
marketing.noCampaigns: No campaign had an order or spend in this period.
marketing.untied: Spend of ad campaigns tied to no campaign: {amount}
marketing.toOverview: Scale, keep, fix or stop? Marketing › Overview
marketing.toReport: Message sends and more: Marketing › Report

how.spend: Ad spend imported per day plus the cost of the messages sent in the period.
how.perTk: Delivered sales of the whole shop divided by all marketing spend. Not known while the spend is not known.
how.profit: The shop's net profit for the same days (Money › Profit & loss).

review.title: Monthly review · {month}
review.sub: The month on one page: what went well, what went badly, what to do next
review.numbersSub: The same figures as Money › Profit & loss for these days.
review.toPacks: Monthly business pack as PDF or Excel

line.salesUp: Delivered sales are up {pct} per day on the span before.
line.salesDown: Delivered sales are down {pct} per day on the span before.
line.profitUp: Net profit is {amount}, up {pct} per day on the span before.
line.profitDown: Net profit is {amount}, down {pct} per day on the span before.
line.loss: The shop lost {amount} after all costs.
line.lowGroup: {name} kept only {pct} of its sales as profit, the lowest of the categories.
line.adsUnknown: Ad spend is missing for part of the month, so net profit is not complete.
line.uncosted: {n} delivered orders are left out of the profit because a product has no cost.
line.unsold: {n} products are in stock but sold nothing.
line.restock: Restock {n} products whose selling sizes are running out.
line.unsoldNext: Put the {n} unsold products into combos or a small discount.
line.checkPrices: Check the prices and discounts of {name}.
line.adsNext: Import the missing ad spend in Marketing › Accounts & tools.
line.costsNext: Enter the missing product costs, then look at the profit again.

how.sales: Delivered sales of the month; the change is per day, so a month so far can be compared.
how.profit: Net profit as in Money › Profit & loss.
how.returns: Parcels that came back ÷ (delivered + came back), all channels (Money › Profit by channel).
how.lines: The went-well and went-badly lines are written by fixed rules from these figures: no AI is used and nothing is sent.
